'''Yev''' was a terrestrial astronomical object that had been [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Womp rat/Legends|Womp rats]],<ref name="TOR" /> [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] from<ref name="Womp Rat">{{TORcite|type=codex|Womp Rat}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Womp Rat" /> had been accidentially introduced to Yev<ref name="TOR" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Outsourcing" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> by which point their penchant for hoarding and their high [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] rate had made them a nuisance to the colonists.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the Sith Empire sent a companion to search for treasure hoarded by the womp rats on Yev. The companion followed a pack of womp rats back to their nest and was led to a crashed [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] containing [[Foodstuff/Legends|inedible]] items hoarded by the pack.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yev was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Outsourcing" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
